Plumbing services

Residential and commercial plumbing across San Antonio and the surrounding areas.

All services

  • Drain cleaning

    Slow sinks, backed up toilets, or a main line that keeps clogging. We clear the drain and find out why it happened.

    View service

  • Sewer camera inspection

    See exactly what is happening inside your drain or sewer line before you pay for a repair.

    View service

  • Water heater repair and installation

    Cold showers, a leaking tank, or a heater near the end of its life. We repair and install water heaters for homes and businesses.

    View service

  • Water treatment and softeners

    Hard water is tough on your fixtures, your water heater and your pipes. We install systems that make it easier on all of them.

    View service

  • Leak detection and repair

    A high water bill or a damp spot that will not dry usually means water is going somewhere it should not. We find it and fix it.

    View service

  • Burst pipes and urgent repairs

    Water spraying, flooding, or a line that just broke. Call us right away. Weekends are for scheduled and emergency work.

    View service

  • Faucet and fixture replacement

    A dripping faucet wastes water every day, and a new fixture can change how a whole kitchen or bathroom feels.

    View service

  • General plumbing repair

    Leaking valves, pressure that is too high or too low, or old work that was never done right. We fix it properly.

    View service

  • Under slab tunnel work

    When a pipe breaks under your foundation, tunneling lets us reach it from outside so the floors inside can stay in place.

    View service

  • Commercial plumbing

    A closed restroom or a backed up drain affects your customers and your staff right away. We get it handled.

    View service

Local, family owned, and here for the long run

JQ Plumbing is owned by Jonathan Quintanilla and his wife. Jonathan is a licensed plumber with 10 years of experience, and our employees are family men too.

We are focused on giving real value and the best customer experience possible. Honest, trustworthy, skilled and reliable is how we work.

Simple, upfront and no surprises.

  1. 1

    Call or send a request

  2. 2

Common questions

Do you give free estimates?

Yes. Estimates are free within San Antonio city limits.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. JQ Plumbing is fully licensed and insured. Our Texas plumbing license is RMP-47009, and our plumbers are fingerprint background checked.

What are your hours?

We are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Weekends are for scheduled and emergency work. We are not a 24 hour service.

What warranty do you offer?

All parts carry the manufacturer warranty. Our workmanship is covered for 90 days to 1 year, depending on the size and scope of the job.

Do you offer any discounts?

Yes. Military, first responders and teachers get a discount with a valid ID.
